blocks.text: Getting your app approved on the App Store and Google Play can be challenging, especially when implementing in-app purchases (IAP) and subscriptions. With stricter guidelines in 2025, understanding what reviewers look for is crucial. This comprehensive guide covers everything you need to pass review on your first submission.

<key>NSCameraUsageDescription</key>
